newGroup.title: Targeted inhibitor source depth and retained catalogue claims

review.auditor: Coordinator scoped follow-up intake; no additional coverage credit
review.rationale: Current field representation and source-depth limits are explicit. This preserves separate work on retained catalogue assertions and source deepening rather than certifying them through a new asOf or an adjacent class definition.

points.requirement: Retained ARPI, CDK4/6, EGFR, BRD4 and PI3K/AKT/mTOR catalogue scalars, older prevalence/resistance figures and linked clinical programmes outside the named corrections need their own current primary checks. The new general CDK class does not independently assess the narrower pending conjugated-payload records.
remaining: Retained ARPI, CDK4/6, EGFR, BRD4 and PI3K/AKT/mTOR catalogue scalars, older prevalence/resistance figures and linked clinical programmes outside the named corrections need their own current primary checks. The new general CDK class does not independently assess the narrower pending conjugated-payload records.

points.requirement: Traina, Carey and O'Reilly full bodies remain inaccessible on the recorded legal routes; their complete abstracts retain their actual scope. Traina CBR stability and single-arm design are independently checked in the matched primary registry. Find a source specifying the short-lived transcript species and response before replacing the current conditional CDK9 assay-reading rule with a general empirical claim. Registry commentaries were not read beyond the listed funding correction.
